# LLM SEO如何衡量从引用到收入的六层指标

作者：@KanishkJagwani4  
日期：2026-10-30（北京时间）  
来源：[X原帖](https://x.com/KanishkJagwani4/status/2115845869358497928)  
分类：方法

## 中文全文

仅靠 LLM SEO，我们就为 B2B 客户创造了1,600万美元。

下面说说我们怎么衡量它。

人们通常最先展示的数字是引用次数。

但引用报告无法告诉你：询盘是否相关，销售是否认可这条线索，或者客户是否买单。

对一家 SaaS 企业，我想知道的是，AI 搜索有没有带来合适的潜在客户、合格线索和付费客户。

首先要检查：这些潜在客户搜索时，你的 SaaS 有没有出现。

## 1. 可见度

哪些购买问题会提到产品？

把品牌相关问题与品类搜索分开。

## 2. 访问

哪些 AI 平台把人带到网站？

他们访问哪些页面？

## 3. 询盘

他们会开始试用、预约演示，或者提出有价值的产品问题吗？

## 4. 线索资格

这些询盘是否符合企业能够服务的客户类型？

一百条不相关线索浪费的时间，可能比创造的价值还多。

## 5. 销售管道与收入

将合格销售机会接入 CRM，并沿着销售流程持续跟踪。

保持归因规则一致。

## 6. 买家告诉你的信息

询问他们最初在哪里听说产品，以及联系你之前研究过什么。

把这些回答与追踪数据放在一起查看。不要把同一个客户计算两次。

然后决定下一步改进什么。

也许对比页有访问，但没有回答迁移相关的问题。

也许使用场景页带来的人更少，却带来更匹配的演示预约。

也许搜索你自己的名字时会出现你，但买家寻找替代方案时，你很少出现。

这些发现才会告诉你应该做什么。

单独一个“引用更多了”做不到。

## 外文原文

We’ve generated $16M for our B2B clients from LLM SEO alone.

Here’s how we measure it.

The number people usually show first is citations.

But a citation report can’t tell you whether the enquiry was relevant, whether sales qualified it or whether the customer bought.

For a SaaS business, I want to know whether AI search brings in the right prospects, qualified leads and paying customers.

That starts with checking whether your SaaS appears when those prospects search.

https://
aizensystems.com/free-audit

1. Visibility

Which buying questions mention the product?

Separate branded questions from category searches.

2. Visits

Which AI platforms send people to the website?

Which pages do they visit?

3. Enquiries

Do they start trials, request demos or ask useful product questions?

4. Qualification

Do those enquiries match the customers the business can serve?

A hundred irrelevant leads can waste more time than they create value.

5. Pipeline and revenue

Connect qualified opportunities to the CRM and follow them through the sales process.

Keep the attribution rules consistent.

6. What buyers tell you

Ask where they first heard about the product and what they researched before contacting you.

Review that alongside the tracked data. Don’t count the same customer twice.

Then decide what to improve next.

Maybe the comparison page gets visits but doesn’t answer migration questions.

Maybe a use-case page brings fewer people but better-fit demos.

Maybe you appear for your own name but rarely show up when buyers ask for alternatives.

Those findings tell you what to work on.

“More citations” on its own doesn’t.
